content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** at Section 2.2 (p0013).

- **Issue:** The clause binds us as Customer to Vendor as "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — full-term exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit, which is walk-away territory and fails the fallback (category-limited, 12 months, automatic end on missed SLAs/delivery dates).
- **Supporting inconsistency:** Section 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge we made no exclusivity commitment, so deletion also resolves an internal conflict.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** delete Section 2.2, with the 12-month category-limited fallback offered in the comment as a compromise.
- **Not flagged here:** the Section 2.1 take-or-pay minimum volume, which belongs to a separate rule.
